entries.61447941829a5e2a: In this business, the consolidated subsidiary Pelican Co., Ltd. sells toys, stationery and other goods at Pelican stores. entries.6d729e1b9835d376: This business provides management support to acupuncture and moxibustion bone-setting clinics. It includes providing the core system A-COMS and the Artra Billing Service, which handles claims for medical expense reimbursement on behalf of clinics; selling equipment and consumables for self-pay treatments; expanding the Honetsugi Chain; operating the product sales support system HONEY-STYLE and the Artra Academy; and franchising Honetsugi Day Services. It is carried out by the Company, Artra Finance Co., Ltd., Artra Care Co., Ltd., Artra Planning Co., Ltd., and Happy Life Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,357 million.
